  {"step":10,"file":"src/flb_parser_regex.c","function":"flb_parser_regex_do","line":212,"var":"tmp_sbuf.data,tmp_sbuf.size","code":"if (parser->decoders) { ret = flb_parser_decoder_do(parser->decoders, tmp_sbuf.data, tmp_sbuf.size, &dec_out_buf, &dec_out_size); }","note":"If decoder rules are present, the msgpack record is handed to the decoder pipeline for further processing."},
  {"step":11,"file":"src/flb_parser_decoder.c","function":"flb_parser_decoder_do","line":214,"var":"in_buf,in_size","code":"msgpack_unpack_next(&result, in_buf, in_size, &off); map = result.data;","note":"The decoder unpacks the msgpack map and iterates over string fields, using lengths derived from the earlier regex capture."},
